records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Vantage Works
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Cancellation confirmed. If there's anything we could've done differently, I'd appreciate hearing it -- always trying to get better.

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Works!
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Your workspace for Vantage Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 ([email:8781f02d] window) and a getting started call was held ([calendar:f89c9c1e]), showing some engagement, but no reply to either Wrenfield email, no invite sent, no tickets, and no key milestone in 6 days. Starter, solo admin, 8 days left — momentum looks low but not dead.

draft.subject: One next step for Vantage Works
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week — good to talk through how Vantage Works wants to use Wrenfield.

You've already got your first project in place, which is the main thing. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting a few real tasks into that project and bringing someone else in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk through that first batch of tasks with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
